name: Boulevard
summary: Booking, point of sale and client management for salons, spas and self-care businesses.
best_for: salons, spas and clinics with staff to schedule and a front desk to run — the per-location pricing works out fine for one busy site
skip_if: you are a solo practitioner with a calendar and a card reader, because the entry tier at $143 a month is priced for a team, and multi-location owners should price the add-ons per site before comparing
honest_knock: Two things about this price list. It is per location, so the arithmetic for a second salon is not a volume discount, it is double — and the add-ons are per location too, which compounds it. And the prices you see are annual-billing rates: the page opens on its Annually tab and the toggle puts monthly billing about 11% higher ($159 against $143 on Essentials, read 4 October 2026), so the sticker is the cheapest version of the number. Two of the three tiers still show that sticker struck through against a higher 'normally' figure, footnoted on 17 September 2026 as a limited-time offer for new customers only, and relabelled 'fall pricing' by 4 October on the same terms; treat the higher number as the list price a renewal may return to. Essentials shows what that looks like when the music stops: on 18 August it was $140 against a struck-through $176, and a month later the discount and the comparison are both gone and it reads $143. The third thing is not a price at all: you cannot buy this without booking a demo. That is a signal about how the deal is done, and it means the published numbers are a starting point rather than a checkout.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per location a month (Essentials) on annual billing, with paid add-ons on top
pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (2026-09-17, read on their own pricing page; re-read 2026-10-04, annual amounts unchanged) Priced per location per month, and the page opens on its Annually tab, so the headline figures are annual-billing rates: Essentials $143, Premier $234 and Prestige $328 per location. The toggle's own label says Save 10% on annual; switched to Monthly on 4 October 2026 the cards read $159, $260 (normally $325) and $364 (normally $455), about 11% above the annual figures. Premier and Prestige still carry the sticker, relabelled from summer to fall pricing by 4 October 2026, — $234 against a 'normally' $293 and $328 against $410, footnoted limited-time and new customers only — but Essentials no longer does: it lost the struck-through $176, rose from $140 to $143 since we read the page on 18 August 2026, and had its allowances raised to 250 texts, 1,000 email blasts and 50 GB of storage. Prestige lists 100 GB. Enterprise is a bespoke quote and a separate Medspa tab carries its own bundles. Paid add-ons sit on top, also per location: Forms from $65 per month per location, QuickBooks $45, ePrescribe $45 per prescriber, and email beyond the included allowance at $0.01 each. Every tier's button is 'Get a demo': there is no self-serve checkout at any price.
